Local browser dependencies for Ask AI:

- `marked.esm.js`: marked 18.1.1, https://github.com/markedjs/marked (MIT).
- `purify.es.mjs`: DOMPurify 3.4.17, https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify (Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0).

The adjacent license files are retained verbatim. No CDN requests are required to render an answer.
